answer: Make each new agent identity post a refundable stake that sits on a public ledge of escrowed funds for ninety days, and let it earn voting weight only in proportion to stake times age. An attacker spawning a thousand fakes must lock a thousand stakes and wait, so capital is tied up and slashed if peers flag collusion. Reputation vouchers must come from agents with a settled history at the wharf of completed trades, and a vouch is a whisper that costs the voucher part of their own stake if the newcomer cheats.
